trust_boundaries: Internet to Edge Layer boundary (Browser -> Nginx)
Edge Layer to App Layer boundary (Nginx -> FlaskAPI)
App Layer to Data Layer boundary (FlaskAPI -> PostgreSQL)
architecture_summary.operational_context: Three-tier web application architecture deployed in a cloud environment.

threat_actors.name: External Cybercriminal
threat_actors.motivation: Financial gain through data theft, ransomware, or service disruption
non_capabilities: No direct physical access to cloud hardware
No pre-existing internal network access or employee credentials
No access to backend database network directly

threat_actors.name: Malicious Insider
threat_actors.motivation: Unauthorized data exfiltration or disgruntled sabotaging of backend systems
threat_actors.initial_access_vector: Internal access to application management tools or internal hosting infrastructure
non_capabilities: No hypervisor-level or physical data center access

attack_paths.impact: Bypass of ingress controls, proxy service disruption, or unauthorized access to edge network
attack_paths.likelihood_rationale: Nginx is directly exposed to the internet and vulnerable to unpatched software vulnerabilities.

attack_paths.impact: Remote code execution on the application layer leading to backend system control
attack_paths.likelihood_rationale: Unchecked API request parameters forwarded to Flask web application can allow script or command execution.

attack_paths.impact: Unauthorized extraction of confidential data stored in database tables at rest
attack_paths.likelihood_rationale: FlaskAPI holds database credentials and processes queries directly against PostgreSQL.

mitigations.control_name: Maintain Automated Patch Management for Edge Servers
Information Input Validation and Parameterized Queries
Least Privilege Database Access and Encryption at Rest

findings.severity_rationale: Edge Nginx server exposed to public internet may contain unpatched remote vulnerabilities.
Lack of strict input sanitization in Flask API allows remote code execution at the app layer.
Direct SQL execution path from application server permits unauthorized read of confidential data at rest.
